steps.title: Train to 95+ Slayer to level …
steps.text: Train to 95+ Slayer to level your combat stats efficiently and unlock lots of gear along the way. — All of the below monsters and bosses should be killed on a Slayer task. — If you want to raid early, the sections farther down include some example setups.

steps.title: (Optional) Kill Basilisk Knights for a …
steps.text: (Optional) Kill Basilisk Knights for a Basilisk jaw

steps.title: Kill Lizardman shamans for a Dragon …
steps.text: Kill Lizardman shamans for a Dragon warhammer

steps.title: Kill Tormented Demons to get an …
steps.text: Kill Tormented Demons to get an Emberlight and Purging staff. The other items are optional

steps.title: Kill Demonic Gorillas for a Necklace …
steps.text: Kill Demonic Gorillas for a Necklace of anguish, Amulet of Torture, and a Tormented Bracelet

steps.title: Kill Spiritual mages for Dragon boots
steps.text: Kill Spiritual mages for Dragon boots

steps.title: Kill abyssal demons for an abyssal …
steps.text: Kill abyssal demons for an abyssal whip

steps.title: (Optional) Kill Cave kraken for a …
steps.text: (Optional) Kill Cave kraken for a trident of sea and make a trident of the swamp. The kraken tentacle is optional as well. — This is optional because you can just go for an Eye of ayak later and skip the trident.

steps.title: Kill Cerberus for the 3 crystals. …
steps.text: Kill Cerberus for the 3 crystals. — Optionally only go for Prims now and come back for the others once you have the Avernic treads

steps.title: Kill Araxxor for the Amulet of …
steps.text: Kill Araxxor for the Amulet of rancour and a Noxious halberd

steps.title: Kill the Thermonuclear smoke devil for …
steps.text: Kill the Thermonuclear smoke devil for an occult necklace

steps.title: Kill the Alchemical hydra for Ferocious …
steps.text: Kill the Alchemical hydra for Ferocious gloves and a dragon hunter lance

steps.title: You want some way to get …
steps.text: You want some way to get to your house while on different spellbooks. Some ideas include: — Construct. cape — Explorer's ring 4 with a spirit tree in Port Sarim. Having the ring on you is nice to be able to use the alchemy effect when not on the standard spellbook. — Any teleport near a Fairy Ring such as the Quest Point Cape with a fairy ring in your POH — The Rada's blessing 3 teleports you near a minecart, which can take you near the Spirit Tree in Hosidius if you have that. — Just make a lot of teleport to house tablets. They can be made relatively easily using soft clay rocks.

steps.title: Some way to get tasks, ideally …
steps.text: Some way to get tasks, ideally from Duradel. Some ideas include: — Karamja gloves 3 or Karamja gloves 4 — Use Astral Contact, can be done from your POH after swapping to lunars at your altar — Have a spirit tree in Brimhaven and take the cart to Shilo Village

steps.title: Bring whatever runes you would like …
steps.text: Bring whatever runes you would like for the spells you plan to use. Using teleport portals in your POH allows you to avoid carrying a lot of basic teleport runes

steps.title: Break down and bag your crystal …
steps.text: Break down and bag your crystal helm as a crystal armour seed. — You could consider breaking down your other crystal armour pieces to clear space. They are not required for much, and the blowpipe can be used for ranged when you need it.

steps.title: Start out with a lot of …
steps.text: Start out with a lot of point boosting to get all the unlocks and blocks you want up front

steps.title: If you would like, it is …
steps.text: If you would like, it is easy to make a lot of combination runes using twisted extracts. This could be useful depending on which spells you decide to bring with you

steps.title: An Occult altar is really nice, …
steps.text: An Occult altar is really nice, as well as other house upgrades

steps.title: Make sure to have the landing …
steps.text: Make sure to have the landing site built to get to your Blue Moon storage quickly

steps.title: Remember that Emberlight is really good …
steps.text: Remember that Emberlight is really good on demon tasks once you get it. It is actually viable to tailor a block/skip list with a focus on doing demon and burst tasks

steps.title: You should probably use Prayer potions …
steps.text: You should probably use Prayer potions for most tasks, but if you would like Bones to peaches is a good option for normal food during tasks

steps.title: Optionally bring a dps special attack …
steps.text: Optionally bring a dps special attack weapon or other useful weapons such as your Toxic blowpipe

steps.title: Your Chugging barrel can carry useful …
steps.text: Your Chugging barrel can carry useful potions, and can be refilled periodically by making new potions from seed drops or by storing potions in smaller stacks in death storage. Example setup: — Ranging potions — Super combat potions — Super restores — Saradomin brews — Goading potions (for burst tasks))
